note: Classifier classification stage only. Scores a flat spectrum; extraction is a separate stage. The character plugin remains the final authority on discovery and expression.

emotion.why: Apathy is neither influence nor a narrative signal.

removed.discourse: Removed 2026-10-11. Declarations of denial/correction are better served by the memory system than by a classifier bucket; keep the Classifier job simple and efficient.

scout.note: Nomination only; Scout requires an applied structured record before it acts. No analysis. off_field is included because off-field events can become availability.

influencer.note: emotional_charge: any defined emotion above threshold. In practice a narrative-vs-procedural filter; Influencer abstains when no reading is supported. off_field flows here per user instruction.

journalist.note: Intentionally broad: the whole relevant current scope.
